quotes.author: Greg Schroeder
quotes.text: We had an amazing time with Boats To You Rentals! Our family cruise around the Lake Conway Chain of Lakes was the highlight of our week. Captain Mike was professional, punctual, knowledgeable about the area, and made sure everyone felt safe and comfortable. It was so relaxing to just sit back and enjoy the scenery while everything was handled for us. If you’re looking to do something different in South Orlando, I cannot recommend this enough. It’s a great escape from the typical tourist spots and just fun for the whole family. We will definitely be booking with him again!

quotes.author: Michael Krohl
quotes.text: We had the best experience with Boats to You Rentals! The boat was in the water and ready to go by the time we arrived. Captain Mike went over everything and made sure my grandchildren were fitted with the very best life jackets. We're all looking forward to our next boating adventure with Boats to You!

quotes.author: Scott Allen
quotes.text: Mike was very responsive, he met us at the dock gave me a quick tour of the boat and we were off. The boat is in great shape with Bluetooth speakers built-in so you can listen to music. The lake he met us on is beautiful for fishing. We had an awesome time. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Michelle
quotes.text: Rented a Bayliner boat with the tube on the back for my brother's birthday and we had a blast! Captain Mike was a good time, he made sure we were comfortable and made it fun! Plus I was able to bring my two corgis along for the ride which made it even better!

quotes.author: SUSHMA C MOTHUKURI
quotes.text: We had an amazing experience. Captain Mike was very flexible and easy to work with. He provided everything that we asked for. The views were excellent. Can’t wait to go back.

quotes.author: Allen King
quotes.text: Top notch experience. Mike met us at the Saint John River boat launch and got us all in the boat and met us there again 6 hrs later. Very reasonable rates and clean boat.
